(Currently Amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced approximately sixteen inches on center.

(Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 2, wherein the studs are spaced about sixteen inches on center.

(Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, and at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

(Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 6, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening to an indoor area.

(Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 11, wherein the housing includes a front cover.

(Currently Amended) The cooling system kit of claim 15, further including instructions for installation and operation of the cooling system.

(Currently Amended) A cooling system, comprising: in a structure wall, a cooling system designed for evaporatively cooling an indoor area. 

(Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 18, wherein the means for mounting includes placing the cooling system between wall studs spaced approximately sixteen inches on center.
